description: This file defines the 'Country' entity class for the sales management application, including its fields, mappings to database tables, and relationships to other entities such as GeoZone, Zones, and descriptions.

classes.name: Country
classes.description: Entity class representing a country with properties such as iso code, supported flag, associated zones, descriptions, and geozone.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the country (transient property).

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the country (transient property).

methods.name: Country
methods.description: Default constructor for the Country entity.

methods.name: Country
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the country with an ISO code.

methods.name: getSupported
methods.description: Returns whether the country is supported.

methods.name: setSupported
methods.description: Sets the supported flag for the country.

methods.name: getIsoCode
methods.description: Returns the ISO code of the country.

methods.name: setIsoCode
methods.description: Sets the ISO code of the country.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the primary key ID of the country entity.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the primary key ID for the country entity.

methods.name: getZones
methods.description: Returns the list of zones associated with the country.

methods.name: setZones
methods.description: Sets the list of zones for the country.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Returns the list of descriptions for the country.

methods.name: setDescriptions
methods.description: Sets the list of descriptions for the country.

methods.name: getGeoZone
methods.description: Returns the GeoZone associated with the country.

methods.name: setGeoZone
methods.description: Sets the GeoZone for the country.
